feature_scope: Iron-rich hyperacidic hydrothermal system and Fe-mineral precipitation
source_title: A Polyextreme Hydrothermal System Controlled by Iron: The Case of Dallol at the Afar Triangle
evidence_relation: The primary paper explicitly calls Dallol a terrestrial Martian analogue site and documents Fe-rich hydrothermal brines and mineral precipitation; the additional study characterizes biological limits across polyextreme gradients.
limitations: Geochemical and mineral-precipitation analogue only; does not establish whole-site terrain equivalence. The Nature study is not relied on alone as a Mars-analogue designation.

feature_scope: Antarctic dry-valley microclimate zonation and geomorphic processes relevant to Mars climate interpretation
source_title: Antarctic dry valleys: Microclimate zonation, variable geomorphic processes, and implications for assessing climate change on Mars
evidence_relation: The Icarus paper explicitly connects Antarctic dry-valley microclimates and geomorphic processes to assessment of climate change on Mars; the additional Science paper documents endolithic microorganisms in the Antarctic cold desert.
limitations: Climate and geomorphology transfer only; local terrestrial microclimates are not equivalent to Martian surface conditions and do not establish broad terrain equivalence.

feature_scope: Hyperspectral infrared mapping of hydrothermal alteration in the Mount Painter Inlier
source_title: Application of hyperspectral infrared analysis of hydrothermal alteration on Earth and Mars
evidence_relation: The study validates airborne and field SWIR mineral mapping at Mount Painter and states that similar hyperspectral surveys could provide detail on putative hydrothermal deposits on Mars.
limitations: Remote-sensing method-transfer analogue; not evidence of identical mineral abundance, alteration history, or site-scale geology.

feature_scope: Volcanic lava-tube subsurface mineralogy, microbial communities, and biosignature preservation
source_title: Connecting molecular biomarkers, mineralogical composition, and microbial diversity from Mars analog lava tubes
evidence_relation: The paper explicitly frames Lanzarote lava tubes as Mars analogs for volcanology and investigates speleothems, mineralogy, microbial communities, and biomarker preservation.
limitations: Lava-tube and biosignature analogue only; does not establish surface-wide equivalence. A 2024 corrigendum exists (DOI 10.1016/j.scitotenv.2024.170811); its specific correction is not interpreted in this audit. The catalogue's unverified 2026 reference is not used.

feature_scope: Carbonate globule mineralogy and abiotic carbon formation mechanisms compared with Martian meteorite ALH 84001
source_title: Comprehensive imaging and Raman spectroscopy of carbonate globules from Martian meteorite ALH 84001 and a terrestrial analogue from Svalbard
evidence_relation: The paper directly compares carbonate globules in ALH 84001 with similar objects in Svalbard mantle xenoliths and identifies similar carbonate/iron-oxide zoning and macromolecular carbon associations.
limitations: Analogue is limited to carbonate-globule mineralogy and inferred abiotic processes in a Martian meteorite; it is not a general Mars surface or landscape analogue.

feature_scope: Deep subsurface evaporite geology, instrument testing, and habitability measurements relevant to Mars exploration
source_title: Planetary science and exploration in the deep subsurface: results from the MINAR Program, Boulby Mine, UK
evidence_relation: The MINAR paper explicitly frames Boulby as an extraterrestrial analogue research programme, noting that present-day habitable conditions on Mars may be restricted to the subsurface; the additional paper reports geochemical and microbial tests of deep mine brines.
limitations: Subsurface geology, instrument development, and habitability analogue only; not a claim that Boulby reproduces Martian pressure, temperature, radiation, or regolith conditions.
